title: NewsNation finds nothing in the Vatican files

tellings.quote: NewsNation itself went to the Vatican and checked in the Vatican files. Said we couldn't find anything.

plain: The American news channel NewsNation went to the Vatican, searched its files for records tied to a claim dated to 1933, and said it could not find anything. Michael Shermer, a researcher and skeptic, says this to Michels without naming where he heard it, as a point against the claim.
